core_obligations: Set up the morphism of ringed topoi and its adjoints

Detect zero objects through eventual constancy
difficulty_reason: Equivalence between the derived complete derived category D_comp(R, I) and the quasi-coherent modules on the inverse-system site: builds the morphism of ringed topoi f : (Sh(N), A) -> (Sh(pt), R), describes Lf^* on K-flat representatives as (K^bullet tensor_R R/I^n) and Rf_* as the derived limit, and proves the essential image by the different-tensors lemma together with the eventual-constancy of M_n tensor_{B_n}^L B_t. Retained author proof at lines 6620-6722.

compared.note: This is the chapter-side statement used by proposition-QC-derived-complete in Sheaves on Algebraic Stacks (different chapter, different claim).
